reviews.text: I typed in everything from our garage on the website and it said about half a truck. They came, looked, and the number was within twenty dollars of the range. No surprises.
reviews.name: Priyanka M.

reviews.text: We were relocating to Denver with nine days to close. They took the sectional, two bunk beds and a treadmill, and texted me a list of what went to donation. That list mattered to my kids.
reviews.name: Brandon L.

reviews.text: Asked if they could take paint cans. Straight answer: no, here is where the county takes them. Then they took everything else. I appreciate a company that says no when it should.
reviews.name: Darlene K.

reviews.text: Old garage fridge, chest freezer and a dead water heater. Gone in forty minutes, dolly and straps, nothing dragged across the floor.
reviews.name: Ofelia G.

reviews.text: After the water came into the downstairs, they pulled the carpet and pad and stacked the wet drywall in the truck the same afternoon the adjuster left. Fast and tidy.
reviews.name: Wes T.

reviews.text: Kitchen remodel leftovers: old cabinets, a granite remnant, eleven boxes of tile scraps. The sheet on their website said quarter truck. It was a quarter truck.
reviews.name: Nadine F.

reviews.text: Mattress and box spring from the guest room, plus a broken crib. Quick, polite, and they told me which recycler the mattress was going to.
reviews.name: Gary P.

proof.guarantee: The price on your sheet is the price you pay, unless you add items on the day.
